content.text: NEWSIs Twitter down right now? Why is Twitter down?Asbury Park PressMarch 23, 2026, 5:24 p.m. ETKeep WatchingIf you're using Twitter, you might not be having a lot of success.According to Downdetector, users are struggling using X, the site formerly known as Twitter. The bugs popped up shortly before 4:30 p.m. EST.According to the site, X's is where most of the problems are, with 60 percent of users finding issues logging on to the website.
